entities.summary: Jyrki Välivaara is a Finnish professional ice hockey defenceman who currently plays for Metallurg Novokuznetsk in the Kontinental Hockey League. In the past he played for JYP of the SM-liiga. He was on Finland's IIHF gold medal-winning team on 2011.
